items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, he did some good work with Nancy Wilson. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. But that was later.

ctx.x: hear you play and usually people like my playing when I play. And Johnny Otis did some records on Capitol and I had heard at Capitol via Dave Cavanaugh, who was a producer and A&R man out there, and he got me on fabulous recordings with Nat Cole and Frank Sinatra and Peggy Lee and Ella Mae Morse. I forget all the people. Capitol was a hot label at the time.
Yeah, he did some good work with Nancy Wilson.
